results.title: Trainwreck: Balloon Boy
results.overview: A homemade flying saucer lifts off, and a 6-year-old boy might be inside. National panic ensues — but what truly happened? This documentary investigates.

results.title: The Websters: Stories on a Spider's Thread
results.overview: Indian Summer has arrived. Amid the excitement and hustle, Daddy Webster gets sick from the rush and can't spin silk. He must rest. By evening, the family gathers at the festive table and recalls their best adventures of the year.

results.title: The Case Diary
results.overview: CI Christy Sam goes to Tamil Nadu as part of capturing some interstate criminals, and at the end of that mission, he happens to find out the fact that his long-lost twin brother, Aju from the orphanage, had died under suspicious circumstances. Christy starts investigation to find out his brother's killer.

results.title: ReUniverse
results.overview: A rare fog weather phenomenon unites parallel universes. A group of old classmates decide to organize a reunion on the night that Athens will be affected by it. As the hours pass, the friends move from one universe to another and calculate where their lives evolved better. Ready even to kill to take their place. Eleni is the only one in the group who doesn't have an alter ego and the only one who can save the friends in every universe. To succeed she has to accept herself and decide what she wants.

results.title: Recurring Gig
results.overview: Jodie and Tyler are two commercial actors who land a gig with a New York-based creative firm to film a series of ads for an energy utility based in Seattle. The energy company is attempting to promote natural gas and fend off electrification in the region, and Jodie and Tyler make the perfect mother-son combo for their propaganda campaign. In between shoots at the studio, where they learn how to pronounce "Puget Sound" and extol the benefits of cooking on gas stove tops, Jodie and Tyler attempt to break out into new roles in their personal lives, from their relationships and identities to their dreams of being taken seriously as actors.

results.title: Nimuendajú
results.overview: Curt Nimuendajú is a German ethnologist who lived in Brazil from 1903 until his death. In addition to having studied and defended the rights of about 50 indigenous peoples, he lived as one of them in each tribe. Nimuendajú died in 1945, in the Amazon, under unknown circumstances.

results.title: Etiology of a Crime
results.overview: Two couples, very close friends, wonderful doctors and architects, people who make decisions for others in decisive problems on a daily basis, live a life of prosperity, and everything seems to feel like a paradise to them. The normal coexists with the pathological. Someone wants more. Passion ravages. Sometimes the road to crime is very simple, just a step. Almost inexplicable to many. A clear view of a world, an above average class, with a seemingly successful and happy existence.

results.title: Rupture à domicile
results.overview: One evening, Eric Vence, founder of "Rupture à domicile" (Home Breakup), is hired by Hyppolite to tell his girlfriend that he has decided to leave her. That's when Eric runs into Gaëlle, his ex who left him seven years ago without any explanation. An unusual love triangle then develops: the ex, the woman, and the soon-to-be ex. Recorded at the Palais des Congrès et des Festivals Atlantia in La Baule.

results.title: Jealous People Are Ugly People
results.overview: Vasilly has become painfully jealous of his best friend, Luke. But things aren’t going so well for Luke. Every time he shares some good news, he starts to suffer from strange and violent repercussions. Disturbed by the uncanny timing, Vasilly recalls his Yiayia’s warnings about the Greek superstition of the evil eye - and starts to believe his own envy might be to blame for Luke’s bad luck. Jealous People Are Ugly People is a darkly comic psychological thriller about male jealousy, inherited superstition, and the corrosive power of repressed ambition.

results.title: Sally
results.overview: Sally Ride's groundbreaking journey as the first American woman in space concealed a deeply personal story. Her life partner, Tam O'Shaughnessy, unveils their covert 27-year romance and its accompanying sacrifices.

results.title: Dragon Girl Problem
results.overview: To escape an arranged marriage in the Dragon Palace, Kim Yong-man, the dragon king's daughter, flees to the human world and begins high school, determined to become the top of her class. There, she encounters Shim Hae-soo, the current number one student sitting beside her. As rivalry shifts into friendship, the two gradually become special to each other.

results.title: Narcisa
results.overview: Narcisa makes her way through the darkness of a disturbing environment to come face to face with a surreal situation that puts her to the test.

results.title: The End was Just the Beginning
results.original_title: O Fim era Apenas o Início
results.overview: When Catarina finds out that she is pregnant, she questions the responsibility of bringing a child into this world.

results.title: Balas Balik
results.overview: A Detective investigates the mysterious death of a CEO, believed to have died from a heart condition. However, uncovering dark secrets and hidden grudges leads him to the true culprit in a gripping tale of oppression, power, and revenge.

results.title: Eloá the Hostage: Live on TV
results.overview: A tragic hostage case from 2008 Brazil unfolds through unseen diary entries, family interviews, and media coverage, as a 15-year-old girl is held captive by her ex-boyfriend for 100 hours while TV networks broadcast it live.

results.title: Stardom in Fuji 2025 Oct.
results.overview: Stardom in Fuji 2025 Oct. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on October 26, 2025, at Fujisan Messe in Fuji, Shizuoka, Japan.

results.title: Dogs and War: What I saw in Ukraine
results.original_title: 犬と戦争: ウクライナで私が見たこと
results.overview: When Russia invaded in February 2022. Japanese director Akane Yamada travelled to the war zone to document an often-overlooked story - the fate of animals and the people who refuse to abandon them. Known for her work in disaster zones since Fukushima, Yamada witnessed animal welfare groups mobilising at the Polish border to help refugees and their pets, and followed Ukrainians who continued to adopt shelter animals amid the chaos. In Borodianka, near Kyiv, she uncovered the tragic deaths of shelter dogs left behind during occupation. Her three-year investigation led her deep into Ukraine's frontline regions, from flooded Kherson after the Kahkovka Dam's destruction to a children's hospital in Kyiv struck by a missile. Through the stories of people who refuse to abandon animals even amid the devastation of war, this documentary portrays the resilience and dignity of those who refuse to surrender to violence.

results.title: Last Stop at The One Stop
results.original_title: Last Stop at The One Stop
results.overview: Three friends attempt to rob a local convenience store in a elaborate heist.

results.title: Madi in China
results.overview: Madi, a young repatriate from China, comes to Kazakhstan at the invitation of the National University to take part in  a prestigious scientific competition. Local students, who are biased against immigrants, prevent Madi from achieving his goal.  Meanwhile, his father asks him to find a missing relative who turns out to be a former criminal. Madi is torn between ambitions and family commitments, trying to find her way in two opposite worlds.

results.title: Sandra
results.overview: Jane's predictable life with her boyfriend is upended when she finds out that a mysterious and erratic woman has been living in her basement.
